failures.title: BMW B47C20U0 Engine Problems - What Actually Fails

items.title: EGR Cooler Failure and Coolant Leaks - 2014-Present models
items.whatHappens: The EGR cooler can develop internal cracks or seal failures, allowing coolant to leak into the exhaust system or intake. In severe cases, this creates a potential fire risk, prompting a major manufacturer recall for affected B47 variants.
items.repairVsReplace: While a standalone EGR cooler replacement costs £600-£1,200 , if the coolant ingress has caused hydrostatic lock or severe internal corrosion, a full BMW B47C20U0 engine replacement is the only safe route. Read our full EGR cooler failure guide.

items.title: Timing Chain and Tensioner Wear - Higher mileage examples
items.whatHappens: Although vastly improved over the notorious N47 rear-chain design, the B47C20U0 front-mounted timing chain can still stretch or experience tensioner wear at higher mileages, presenting as a rattling noise on cold starts.
items.repairVsReplace: A chain kit replacement is a standard maintenance item at this mileage. However, if the chain has jumped a tooth or snapped, catastrophic valve damage occurs, necessitating a full unit replacement.

failures.goodYearsLine: The B47C20U0 benefits from the front-mounted chain design and updated EGR components post-recall, making it significantly more robust than its N47 predecessor, provided regular oil changes with the correct BMW Longlife specification are maintained .
failures.cta: → Compare rebuilt BMW B47C20U0 prices with the failure already addressed

variants.title: How to Confirm You Have the B47C20U0
variants.intro: ═══════════════════════════════════════ The B47C20U0 is a specific transverse/front-wheel-drive biased tune of the broader B47 family, typically producing 110 kW (150 hp) and 330 Nm of torque. It can be identified by the engine code stamped on the block, listed on your V5C registration document (Section D.2), or via a VIN decoder. It is most commonly confused with the longitudinal B47D20A or the higher-output B47D20B. Fitting the wrong revision can lead to ECU mapping mismatches, incorrect turbo plumbing, and mounting point discrepancies, as the "C" designation often denotes specific transverse chassis applications (like the X1/X2 or 1/2 Series Active Tourer).

relatives.description: - the notorious predecessor that the B47C20U0 replaced in entry-level trims; the B47's front-mounted timing chain design largely resolved the N47's catastrophic rear-chain failure mode.

the B47C20U0 remains in active production across modern F and G-series chassis, though later B47 revisions (such as the B47TU2) have introduced minor emissions and efficiency updates while retaining the same fundamental architecture.

and - the longitudinal, rear-wheel-drive biased variants of the same B47 family; owners of traditional BMW saloons and SUVs should check these pages, as the transverse "C" designation of the B47C20U0 means it is not a direct swap for the "D" variants.

buyingGuide.title: Buying a Replacement BMW B47C20U0 - What to Choose

options.label: Used
options.body: A used BMW B47C20U0 is only advisable for lower-value host vehicles and must come with documented proof that the EGR cooler recall has been completed and the timing chain is quiet on cold starts. Without this history, the risk of inheriting coolant leak issues is elevated. Explore our vetted used engine network.

options.label: Reconditioned
options.body: This is the most recommended route for the B47C20U0. A proper reconditioning process will systematically replace the EGR cooler, turbocharger seals, and all ancillary gaskets, directly addressing the engine's most common failure points while restoring factory compression. View reconditioned BMW B47C20U0 options.

options.label: Rebuilt
options.body: A full rebuild is justified if the host vehicle is a higher-mileage 3 Series or X3 where long-term ownership is planned. An upgraded rebuild should include a revised timing chain kit, updated oil pump, and a remapped ECU to ensure longevity and optimal emissions performance. Compare rebuilt BMW B47C20U0 specialists.

buyingGuide.supplyFitLine: Choosing a supply-and-fit service through our network ensures the engine is installed by a specialist familiar with the B47's modern electronics and emissions systems, backed by a nationwide warranty. Learn more about supply and fit.
buyingGuide.vehicleValueNote: The B47C20U0 is typically found in vehicles valued between £7,000 and £20,000. Because a full reconditioned replacement can cost upwards of £3,320 fitted, the replacement cost is generally well within the vehicle's value. However, on older, higher-mileage F45/F46 Active Tourer examples approaching the £5,000 mark, evaluate scrap value before committing if the lowest viable replacement cost exceeds approximately 60% of the vehicle's current market value .

mainEntity.name: What is the most common failure with the BMW B47C20U0 engine?

acceptedAnswer.text: The dominant failure is EGR cooler cracking and internal coolant leaks, typically occurring between 60,000 and 120,000 miles. It powers entry-level and mid-range badges such as the 114d, 116d, 216d, 316d, 318d, and sDrive18d. Power outputs typically sit at 110 kW (150 hp) with 330 Nm of torque. Always verify your exact fitment using your registration number.
